implementation_summary.title: Phase 5.2 - Parameter Binding Complete
implementation_summary.description: All 56 parameters (8 global + 48 per-band) successfully bound to WebView UI with bidirectional sync
key_achievements: Correct member declaration order (Relays → WebView → Attachments) prevents crashes
All 56 relays registered with .withOptionsFrom() for JUCE WebView communication
JavaScript bindings with proper value formatting (dB, ms, ratio, %)
Global controls: Input/Output gain, Mix, Auto-Makeup toggle, M/S Mode selector
Per-band controls: 6 knobs (Threshold, Ratio, Attack, Release, Knee, Makeup) × 4 bands
Per-band buttons: Solo, Bypass, SC Listen × 4 bands
Bidirectional sync: UI changes update DSP, automation/presets update UI
Build successful with only warnings (no errors)
Plugin installed and registered with macOS Audio Unit system
technical_highlights: WebSliderRelay: 56 continuous parameters (gain, threshold, ratio, attack, release, etc.)
WebToggleButtonRelay: 13 boolean parameters (solo, bypass, sc_listen, auto_makeup)
Value formatters handle logarithmic parameters (attack/release) correctly
CSS knob styling with radial gradients matches Botanical aesthetic
Toggle buttons show active state with color change
All parameter IDs match APVTS exactly (case-sensitive)
Resource provider serves all UI files from embedded BinaryData
